newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
ALBANIA - July 7 - Two vessels in port, both discharging cement. No vessels waiting in roads.

BULGARIA, July 7 - No labour problems. Varna - Varna east - 5 Vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load. Varna west - 13 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load. Varna lesport/tanker port - No vessels. Bourgas - Bourgas east - 5 Vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 11 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting to discharge. 2 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 13 due. Bourgas west - 2 Vessels loading at berth. Tanker port - 2 Vessels loading at berth.

CROATIA, July 7 - Rasa - One vessel loading at berth. Rijeka - Two vessels discharging at berth, 2 loading at berth, 2 anchored, 11 under repair/dry-docked. 7 Vessels due. zadar - One vessel discharging at berth, 2 loading at berth, 3 under repair/dry-docked. Sibenik - One vessel loading at berth, 1 under repair/dry-docked. split - One vessel loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 1 under repair/dry-docked. Ploce - One vessel loading at berth. Pula, Dubrovnik - No vessels.

CYPRUS, July 8 - Limassol - Eight vessels operating of which 6 container vessels loading/discharging at berth, 2 conventional vessels discharging at berth. 9 Vessels due 9/7 of which 2 containers, 2 conventional vessels, 5 passenger vessels. No delays expected. Larnaca - One container vessel discharging/loading at berth, 2 container vessels due 9/7, no delays expected.

ESTONIA, July 8 - No labour problems. Tallinn - City port - 1 Steel billets vessel loading at berth, 1 container vessel discharging at berth, 1 liner. 5 Vessels due, no delays expected. Kopli - 2 Vessels discharging at berth (1 meat, 1 fish). 5 Vessels due, no delays expected. Muuga - 4 Vessels loading at berth (3 fuel oil, 1 coal). 3 Discharging at berth (1 sugar, 2 containers). 14 Vessels due, no delays. Parnu - Five vessels loading at berth (4 timber, 1 peat moss). 2 Vessels due, no delays.

ITALY, July 8 - Genoa - Commercial port - No vessels in roads, no delays. 24 Vessels berthed, 1 dry-docked. Multedo - Oil harbour - No vessels in roads, 1 berthed, 1 sea platform. Savona - One vessel in roads, no delays, 3 vessels berthed. Vado Ligure - No vessels in roads, no delays, 3 vessels berthed. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays, 7 vessels berthed. Leghorn - Four vessels in roads, 15 berthed. Civitavecchia, Gaeta, Salerno, Palermo, Ancona/Falconara, Venice - No vessels in roads, no delays. Naples - One vessel in roads, no delays. Augusta - Oil harbour - No delays. Syracuse - Oil harbour - No delays. Sarroch - Six vessels in roads, 4 berthed. Taranto - One vessel in roads, 1 berthed, no delays. Ravenna - Three vessels in roads, no delays. Trieste - Commercial port - No delays. Siot oil terminal - 2 Vessels berthed, 4 in roads with some delays expected.

LATVIA, July 8 - No strikes at any port. Riga - 19 Vessels in port, all operating, of which 5 timber loaders, container loaders, 2 tanker loaders, 2 steel loaders, 1 fertiliser loader, 2 frozen food dischargers, 2 awaiting operations, 2 sugar dischargers, 2 other general cargo. No delays, 20 vessels due. Ventspils - Eight vessels in port, all operating, of which 4 steel loaders, 1 mop loader, 2 miscellaneous, 1 ferrous metal loader. 5 Vessels waiting at outer anchorage, no delays.
LITHUANIA, July 7 - Klaipeda - Eight vessels loading (2 fertiliser, 1 cement, 3 metal, 2 scrap). 6 Discharging (4 fish, 1 sugar, 1 corn). 1 Vessel loading/discharging, 2 in roads, 14 due.

POLAND, July 8 - Gdynia - Nine vessels operating of which 6 loading at berth (4 general cargo, 2 coal). 3 Discharging at berth (2 general cargo, 1 grain). 11 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 38 due. Gdansk - Eight vessels operating of which 5 loading at berth (3 bulkers, 2 coal). 3 Discharging at berth (2 general cargo, 1 tanker). 7 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 19 due.

PORTUGAL, July 7 - Leixoes - 14 Vessels operating of which 12 general cargo, 2 containers, no vessels awaiting berths. Vacant places, 4 piers with cranes, 1 pier without cranes. Lisbon - 70 Vessels in port of which 1 loading at berth, 9 discharging at berth, 4 loading/discharging at berth, 3 loading at anchorage. 3 Vessels bunkering, 19 under repair/dry-docked, 4 awaiting orders, 24 miscellaneous, 6 due. July 8 - Sines - Two vessels in port operating of which 1 loading gasoil, 1 metallic structures, 1 awaiting orders waiting to discharge propane. 8 Vessels due of which 5 to discharge (2 crude oil, 2 coal, 1 mtbe). 3 To load (1 fuel oil, 1 propylene, 1 gasoline/gasoil/jet fuel).

ROMANIA, July 7 - Constantza - 36 Vessels operating of which 20 general cargo (16 loading, 4 discharging), 7 bulkers (5 loading, 2 discharging), 3 tankers, all discharging, 2 bagged chemicals, both loading. 2 Bulkers waiting in roads, both to load. Constantza south (Agigea) - 10 General cargo vessels loading. Mangalia - One vessel loading general cargo. Midia - Four livestock carriers loading, 1 tanker discharging.

RUSSIA, July 7 - BALTIC PORTS - Kaliningrad - Commercial port - 10 Vessels operating of which 9 loading (1 saltpetre, 1 steel bars, 1 non-ferrous metals, 1 newsprint, 1 ferro-alloys, 1 fertiliser, 1 pulp logs, 1 coke, 1 steel scrap). 1 Discharging/loading cars, 2 waiting, 6 due. Fishing port - 2 Vessels discharging frozen fish, 3 due, no delays. July 8 - St. Petersburg - 22 Vessels operating of which 13 loading (5 non-ferrous metals, 1 general cargo, fertiliser, 1 containers). 9 Discharging (3 meat/frozen chicken, 1 butter, 2 containers, 1 fertiliser, 1 general cargo, 1 wheat). 10 Vessels waiting, 21 due. Kaliningrad - No strikes. 15 Vessels in port operating, none waiting, no delays, 7 due. Vyborg - No strikes. One vessel in port operating, none waiting, no delays, 6 due.

FAR EASTERN PORTS - July 8 - No delays/strikes/congestion. Vladivostok - 15 Vessels in port of which 2 passenger vessels, loading (1 timber, 2 metal), 2 loading/discharging containers, 6 waiting. Nakhodka - 12 Vessels in port of which 8 loading (5 metal, 3 timber), 4 waiting. Vostochny - 10 Vessels in port of which 6 loading (1 timber, 4 coal, 1 metal). 1 Discharging cars, 3 waiting. Posyet - One vessel loading timber. Zarubino - No vessels.

NORTHERN BASIN - Murmansk - July 8 - Six vessels operating of which 2 alumina, 1 npk, 1 non-ferrous metals, 2 cabotage. No vessels waiting. 8 Vessels due during the week of which 6 loaders (1 coal, 1 npk, 4 apatite). 2 Dischargers (1 alumina, 1 general cargo).

SLOVENIA, July 7 - Koper - 12 Vessels berthed of which 1 loading/discharging containers, 4 general cargo vessels loading sawn timber/rails, 1 bulk carrier loading coal, 1 livestock vessel loading bulls, 4 bulk carriers discharging tin/alumina/coal, 1 tanker discharging gasoline. 11 Vessels due over the next few days of which 5 to load/discharging containers, 1 ferry to load/discharge cars/trucks, 2 car carriers to load cars, 2 general cargo vessels to load rails/sawn timber, 1 bulk carrier to load soya. No delays expected.

SPAIN, July 7 - Bilbao - 20 Vessels operating (2 tankers, 18 dry cargo) of which 8 discharging, 5 loading, 7 loading/discharging, no delays. July 8 - Pasajes - 20 Vessels in port of which 15 discharging (6 scrap, 1 fertiliser, 2 coils, 1 clinker, 3 wood-pulp, 2 steels). 3 Discharging/loading (1 cars, 1 general cargo, 1 steel). 2 Under repair, no delays. Holidays 16, 25 and 31 July.

TURKEY, July 7 - Istanbul - Haydarpasa - 7 Vessels operating (2 containers, ro-ro, 4 dry cargo). No berthing delays. Galata - 8 Cargo/passenger vessels operating, port congested. Ambarli - 16 Vessels operating, no berthing delays.

UKRAINE, July 7 - Mariupol - Nine vessels loading at berth (6 metal products, 1 fertiliser, 1 clay, 1 sulphur). 4 Discharging at berth (1 pvc, 1 alumina, 2 general cargo). 5 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load (3 metal products, 2 fertiliser). 4 Reloading seagoing vessels (2 fertiliser, 1 metal products, 1 urea). 1 Vessel under repair/dry-docked, 8 floating storehouses (7 fertilisers, 1 sulphur). 33 Vessels due of which 14 to discharge (3 fertiliser, 1 clay, 6 containers, 1 coals, 2 general cargo, 1 metal products). 16 To load (4 coals, 9 metal products, 3 clay). 1 To discharge general cargo/load coals, 1 to discharge alumina/load sulphur, 1 to discharge/load containers. Kerch - Two vessels loading metal products at berth, 2 under repair/dry-docked, 1 due. Berdyansk - Three vessels waiting at anchorage to load (1 clay, 2 metal products), 1 due to load fertiliser.
